title: Equity F&O stalled; commodities and lending grew
dek: NSE's options premium turnover rose 3% and futures fell 12%, while MCX's revenue more than doubled and margin-lending books grew about 40% at Angel One and across the industry.

notes: Each bar is a different measure, all year-on-year for Q2 FY27 as stated on the companies' calls: NSE average daily turnover (options on premium), Angel One's average client funding book, Anand Rathi Shares' period-end MTF book, Anand Rathi Wealth's net new money, and 360 ONE's ARR and transaction/brokerage revenue. MCX is shown by revenue from its filed results (+114%) because management gave turnover growth only as 'nearly double'. The industry MTF figure (₹1.56 lakh Cr, +41%) is as of 12 Oct 2026, cited on Anand Rathi Shares' call. Part of the futures fall is from tax changes, and wealth flows were helped by IPO-related liquidity.
